major_cooldowns.name: Arcane Surge
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Pre-cast it just before the pull and then send it on cooldown with Touch of the Magi, holding it only the few seconds it takes to reach an add wave or a vulnerability window.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 365350 is the cast id; 365362 is the self buff and 453326 is the Arcane Phoenix version.

major_cooldowns.name: Time Warp
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Coordinate it with your group, then cast it straight after your opening Arcane Surge so the whole burst window runs inside it.

major_cooldowns.name: Touch of the Magi
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Drop it on the toughest enemy that will live all 12 seconds while an Arcane Barrage or Prismatic Bolt is mid-air, and never sit on it more than a few seconds.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 321507 is the 45s cast; 210824 is the enemy debuff and 210833 was not observed.

rule.description: Open Arcane Surge, Missiles, Barrage, Touch
rule.action: Pre-cast Arcane Surge, then Arcane Missiles into Arcane Barrage, and land Touch of the Magi while the Barrage is still flying.

rule.description: Touch of the Magi with Arcane Barrage mid-air
rule.action: Queue Touch of the Magi the instant Arcane Barrage leaves your hands so the travelling damage lands inside the debuff.

rule.description: Pair every second Touch with Arcane Surge
rule.action: Save Touch of the Magi when Arcane Surge is nearly ready so both go out together, and spend the off-cycle Touch immediately.

rule.description: Spend the Prismatic Bolt proc before it expires
rule.action: Fire Prismatic Bolt as soon as it lights up, since it does not stack and a second proc is lost.

rule.description: Arcane Barrage at full Arcane Charges
rule.action: Build to full Arcane Charges with Arcane Blast or Arcane Orb before you Barrage, outside the Arcane Soul window.

rule.description: Arcane Intellect up for the whole pull
rule.action: Rebuff Arcane Intellect before the pull and again after any death or battle resurrection.
